A blazing fast Git engine
built for cdgen.web.app

Like Forgejo, but lighter. Written in Go. Browse code, view commits, and clone repos — with Blue Cat 😺 as your companion.

⚡ Browse Repos $ git clone https://cdgen.web.app/BlueBix/codegen.git
📁

File Browser

Navigate /:owner/:repo with syntax-highlighted files from data/repos

🕒

Commit History

Full log at /:owner/:repo/commits from data/commit + bare objects

📦

LFS Support

Large files handled in data/lfs, like Forgejo

😺

Avatars & Assets

All icons live in img/ — logo.png & logonotxt.png (transparent)

# data/ layout (Forgejo-like)
data/
  ├─ repos/ — bare .git storage
  ├─ commit/ — parsed commits
  ├─ lfs/ — large file objects
  ├─ avatars/ — user avatars
  ├─ attachments/ + tmp/
img/
  ├─ logo.png — full cat with text
  └─ logonotxt.png — favicon icon only
